items.en: "Right. It worked. And gave me coordinates for something in the Abyss."
"MY discovery. And we'll talk about payment if you want any part in it."
Transfer the data recovered from the sensor array
"No, this is business. Your freelancer failed. Now I can do the job- if you pay."
Transfer the data recovered from the sensor array
"That's not enough. Make it 100k."
"100k or I walk."
"What is it? What were you looking for?"
"Now the payment, please."
"So what is it? What were you looking for?"
"Valuable, you say? Yes, we should discuss payment."
"So what is at those coordinates in the Abyss?
"So about payment..."
"I accept your offer."
"More like 100k, due to hazard. I made it, unlike your freelancer."
"I will forgo payment. Advancement of knowledge is wealth enough."
"I will forgo payment. Advancement of knowledge is wealth enough." (lie)
"So, what does the data mean?"
"My people say it's pointing at a rock in the Abyss. Something happened there."
"If you don't know what, then why? Why this array data? Why these coordinates?"
"Who is your patron? If they're so wealthy, I'm sure I've heard of them."
"Are you sure your patron is only interested in pure discovery?"
"I shall say nothing, of course."
"Tri-Tachyon is backing your project?"
"Are you sure you can't tell me?"
"I feel they are a kindred spirit. Indeed, are not we three all?"
"I shall say nothing, of course." (lie)
"I shall say nothing, of course."
Leave him to his musing
"I haven't actually gone to the rogue planet yet."

"I'm calling about your daughter, Scylla."
"Comms more often? She's been in contact? But you said..."
"I don't think I've emphasized how important it is for me to find Scylla and Elissa."
"It's extremely important. The fate of the Persean Sector is at stake!"
"I'm not from Fleet, ma'am. I run an independent operation."
"I found Scylla on Laicaille Habitat, then..." (explain)
"Wonderful. Well, I shouldn't take any more of your time..."
"I need to get back to my $shipOrFleet. Goodbye."
"And, um, that's all there is to tell."
"And then Scylla and Zal disappeared. I don't know where to."
"Then they disappeared together. I'm trying to find them."
